LESSON: EFFECTS OF BUSINESS TRANSACTIONS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: BUSINESS STUDIES
Strand: Financial Records in Business
Topic 4.2: Effects of Business Transactions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Effects of Business Transactions, part of Financial Records in Business in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 BUSINESS STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How do business transactions affect the statement of the financial position of a business?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. analyse the effects of business transactions on the statement of financial position for a business,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Effects of Business Transactions in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. prepare a statement of financial position after adjustments to determine the net worth of a business,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Effects of Business Transactions in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. recognise the effects of transactions when determining the net worth of a business. ● in groups, learners discuss and present on the effects of business transactions on the statement of financial position for a business, ● in pairs, learners are guided to compute the effects of transactions on the statement of financial position for a business, ● in pairs learners are guided to draw a statement of financial position to determine the net worth of a business after adjustments. How do business transactions affect the statement of the financial position of a business? 45

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Effects of Business Transactions in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. analyse the effects of business transactions on the statement of financial position for a business,

   Effects of Business Transactions helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. prepare a statement of financial position after adjustments to determine the net worth of a business,

   Effects of Business Transactions helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. recognise the effects of transactions when determining the net worth of a business. ● in groups, learners discuss and present on the effects of business transactions on the statement of financial position for a business, ● in pairs, learners are guided to compute the effects of transactions on the statement of financial position for a business, ● in pairs learners are guided to draw a statement of financial position to determine the net worth of a business after adjustments. How do business transactions affect the statement of the financial position of a business? 45

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Effects of Business Transactions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: learner enhances effective communication skills when discussing and presenting on the effects of

business transactions and preparing statements of financial position for businesses.

● Critical thinking and problem solving: learner enhances evaluation and decision making skills when computing the

effects of business transactions on the statement of financial position for businesses.

● Learning to learn: learner develops skills of working collaboratively when discussing and presenting on effects of

business transactions.

Values:
● Respect: learner shows regard for the contributions of every member of the team when discussing and presenting

on the effects of business transactions and preparing statements of financial position for businesses.

● Responsibility: learner performs tasks assigned when computing the effects of business transactions on the

statement of financial position for a business and drawing a statement of financial position.

● Love: learner respects others when discussing and presenting on the effects of business transactions on the

statement of financial position for a business.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Peer Education and Mentorship: learner enhances interpersonal relationships when discussing and presenting on

the effects of business transactions on the statement of financial position for a business.

● Financial Literacy: learner financial skills are enhanced when preparing a statement of financial position for a

business.
